author: vikingdizee
quote: This game isn't even worth what you pay for it on sale. It's a textbook case of copy-and-paste. They're only focused on cramming cards into the Ultimate mode but have neglected everything else. The menus are very basic—they have zero flair. They were better 10 years ago, and it's been all downhill since then. I'm super disappointed with this series. Do something about it.

author: vikingdizee
quote: This is my first time playing *Ocarina of Time*, so I played it without any preconceived notions or the filter of nostalgia; I’d only played the other two Zelda games on the Switch 1.I was surprised by how fantastic the game’s controls are, as well as the music that caresses your senses while you play.I 100% recommend this game.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: vikingdizee
quote:
Genuinely boring. Feels nothing like gta. Its very bad for 13.5 years of waiting -30 fps and blurry. Not enough freedom. And it can't be released with those bugs—please.
 Also they tried to be like RDR2 but the pacing in RDR2 only worked because of the time period and setting. It felt cool to explore that world because it was unknown and romantic. In GTA 6 nothing is unique or fun to explore, the scenery is really beautiful, but that's about it. And the characters are boring too, no chemistry between any of them. The voice actor for Jason sounds like he doesn't want to live. 
The game looks great, sure, but that's all it has going for it. They've taken away the freedom we had in the previous GTA games. They're taking away our freedom to drive whatever car we want and instead force us into a **** RED HULK.
